model: T8800 Series Touch Screen Fan Coil Thermostat (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Two- and four-pipe fan coils with three-speed fans and on/off or modulating valves, using the T8800 touch screen thermostat (TF20, TB20, TB21).
summary: The T8800 is a compact touch screen fan coil thermostat with BACnet MS/TP. Its 18 objects cover the three fan speed relays, the valve outputs, room temperature, setpoint, power, mode, fan speed, occupancy and an error code. VLV-2 exists only on the TF20 and VLV-M only on the TB21.
notes: Objects from Table 3 on pages 4-5 of Technical Bulletin Rev 1.0; descriptions from section 3.2.

The table has no access column. Access is inferred: inputs, EFF-ZNT and ERROR read-only; outputs, POWER and OCC-S (the guide says OCC-S can be overridden at priority 8) commandable; the other values writable.
Multistate state text is listed in the order printed; the table gives no state numbers.
The device object (DEV-1) is not listed as a point.

source.title: T8800 series BACnet MS/TP Networked Thermostat Controller Technical Bulletin

integration.summary: Set the MAC address at the thermostat, discover it on the BACnet MS/TP trunk, then command POWER, ORP-MODE, FAN-S and ZN-SP. Read EFF-ZNT, OCC-S and ERROR.

minimum_points.name: FAN-S
minimum_points.why: Fan speed: Auto, Low, Med or High

minimum_points.name: OCC-S
minimum_points.why: Occupancy; BAS can override at priority 8

minimum_points.name: ERROR
minimum_points.why: Error status: OK, E1, E2, HI, LO

integration.enable: POWER (BV 1101) turns the fan coil on or off. LC-PWR-PRI (MV 1305) decides whether the touch button writes power at priority 16 (Normal) or priority 8 (High, held for 6 hours), which matters if the BAS also commands POWER.
integration.remote_sensors: RZN-T (AI 1008) reads a wired remote sensor; the guide lists no BAS-written temperature object.
setup: MS/TP MAC address 4 to 128; the factory value 128 is not valid for a master, so set the MAC before connecting.
Baud rate default is Auto; fixed choices are 1200, 9600, 19200, 38400 and 76800.
Enter the setting menu with the fan coil off by holding the fan and up keys for 5 seconds; MAC is setting 1 and baud rate setting 10.
No on-board end-of-line termination; fit terminators on the first and last devices.
gotchas: With LC-PWR-PRI = High a local power press holds priority 8 for 6 hours and can mask a lower-priority BAS command.
OCC-S follows the occupancy contact when no remote sensor is fitted; a BAS write at priority 8 overrides it.
CLG-ONLY on TB20/TB21: a remote change to heating is reverted to cooling by the thermostat.

points.name: VLV-1
points.description: Valve output; cooling valve on TF20, cool/heat valve on TB20

points.name: HW-OCC
points.description: Occupancy contact; shares the input with RZN-T

points.name: CLG-ONLY
points.description: Cooling and ventilation only; TB20 and TB21

points.name: OCC-S
points.description: Occupancy status; BAS can override at priority 8

points.name: LC-PWR-PRI
points.description: Priority used for local power commands
